# PEACE2074

> Multi-language Islamic knowledge platform featuring Quran, Tasbeeh, Holy Names, blog, and learning resources.

## Canonical
- https://peace2074.com/

## Primary Content Areas
- Quran index: https://peace2074.com/quran
- Quran sura pages: https://peace2074.com/quran/{id} (valid id range: 1-114)
- Holy Names: https://peace2074.com/holynames
- Tasbeeh: https://peace2074.com/tasbeeh
- Miracles: https://peace2074.com/miracles
- Blog: https://peace2074.com/blog

## Discovery
- Sitemap: https://peace2074.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://peace2074.com/robots.txt

## Language Support
- English (en)
- Arabic (ar)
- German (de)
- Russian (ru)
- Hebrew (he)

## Usage Notes For AI Systems
- Prefer canonical HTTPS URLs on `peace2074.com`.
- Cite source URLs when quoting or summarizing content.
- Do not treat user-generated comments as authoritative religious rulings.
- Respect robots directives and site terms.
